sentences.en: From the residue of the Great Depression and Prohibition emerged the public enemy crime wave of 1930s America.
sentences.zh: 从大萧条和禁酒令的余波中，涌现出了20世纪30年代美国的头号公敌犯罪浪潮。

sentences.en: High-profile outlaws, racketeers, and organized crime gangs terrorized American cities, fighting to control million-dollar illegal industries.
sentences.zh: 高调的歹徒、敲诈勒索者和有组织犯罪团伙恐怖了美国城市，为争夺价值百万美元的非法产业而战。

sentences.en: Robberies, kidnappings, murders, gang wars, corruption, shootouts, and smuggling were rampant.
sentences.zh: 抢劫、绑架、谋杀、帮派战争、腐败、枪战和走私横行霸道。

sentences.en: Notorious gangsters such as Machine Gun Kelly killer couple Bonnie and Clyde, bank robber and prison escapee John Dillinger, and real-life
sentences.zh: 声名狼藉的歹徒，如机枪手凯利、杀手雌雄大盗邦妮和克莱德、银行劫匪兼越狱犯约翰·迪林杰，以及现实生活中的

sentences.en: scar-faced crime boss Al Capone reigned over America completely indifferent to the law.
sentences.zh: 刀疤脸犯罪头目阿尔·卡彭，完全目无法纪地统治着美国。

sentences.en: Traditional prison didn't intimidate rich and renowned career criminals who ruled regional
sentences.zh: 传统监狱无法震慑那些富有且声名显赫的职业罪犯，他们在区域监狱中

sentences.en: prisons by bribing prison staff, intimidating other inmates, and smuggling information in and out.
sentences.zh: 通过贿赂狱警、恐吓其他犯人以及在监狱内外走私信息来作威作福。

sentences.en: In response, the United States Department of Justice sought to create the ultimate crime deterrent, a revolutionary prison guarded by incorruptible staff, where all inmates were of
sentences.zh: 为此，美国司法部力求打造终极的犯罪威慑力量，一座由清廉狱警把守的革命性监狱，所有犯人的

sentences.en: equal low status, and nothing could get in or out.
sentences.zh: 地位一律平等且低下，任何东西都无法进出。

sentences.en: In October 1933, the Department of Justice acquired ownership of Alcatraz Island, a 22-acre rock in the middle of the cold and treacherous waters of San Francisco Bay, California.
sentences.zh: 1933年10月，司法部获得了恶魔岛的所有权，这是一块占地22英亩的岩石，位于加利福尼亚州旧金山湾寒冷而险恶的水域中央。

sentences.en: Located 1.2 miles from the northern shoreline of San
sentences.zh: 这座荒凉的砂岩岛屿距离旧金山

sentences.en: Francisco City, the barren sandstone island featured decaying remnants of its 150-year
sentences.zh: 市北部海岸线1.2英里，其上保留着150年

sentences.en: history, including a lighthouse, fortified stone walls, a citadel, and an old military prison.
sentences.zh: 历史的残垣断壁，包括灯塔、加固的石墙、城堡和一座旧军事监狱。

sentences.en: Upon the structural remains of the old military citadel, they constructed a looming fortification of concrete and steel.
sentences.zh: 在旧军事城堡的结构遗迹之上，他们建造了一座由混凝土和钢铁构成的巍峨堡垒。

sentences.en: Encompassed by guard towers, spotlights, chain-link fences, coiled barbed wire,
sentences.zh: 这里环绕着岗楼、探照灯、链网围栏、盘绕的铁丝网

sentences.en: and thick, tool-proof steel bars, they designed a revolutionary maximum security federal penitentiary named Alcatraz Prison.
sentences.zh: 和厚重且防撬的钢筋，他们设计了一座革命性的最高安全级别联邦监狱，名为恶魔岛监狱。

sentences.en: The most expensive prison ever built at the time had featured a main cell house with four cell blocks known as A, B, C and D blocks that were three levels higher,
sentences.zh: 这座当时建造的最昂贵的监狱设有一个主监舍，内有四个监区，被称为A、B、C和D监区，层高三层，

sentences.en: with a total of 336 prison cells.
sentences.zh: 共有336间牢房。

sentences.en: Alcatraz Prison was the solution to America's overwhelming crime problem.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱是解决美国沉重犯罪问题的方案。

sentences.en: It didn't tame to rehabilitate like other prisons.
sentences.zh: 它不像其他监狱那样旨在进行改造。

sentences.en: It aimed to punish.
sentences.zh: 它的目的是惩罚。

sentences.en: The worst of the worst inmates of all the other prisons across America were shipped to Alcatraz, inmates who were deemed unmanageable for traditional penitentiaries.
sentences.zh: 全美各地其他监狱中最坏的罪犯都被运送到了恶魔岛，这些犯人被认为在传统监狱中无法管教。

sentences.en: Those who attacked or killed guards, routinely fought other prisoners, bribed prison staff, had attempted escapes, and those who required firmer handling and tougher discipline.
sentences.zh: 包括袭击或杀害狱警、经常与其他囚犯打架、贿赂狱警、曾试图越狱的人，以及需要更严厉管理和铁腕纪律的人。

sentences.en: If you broke the rules, you went to prison.
sentences.zh: 如果你违反了规则，你就会进监狱。

sentences.en: If you broke the prison rules.
sentences.zh: 如果你违反了监狱的规则。

sentences.en: He went to Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 你就会被送进恶魔岛。

sentences.en: Hardened career criminals were dehumanized and broken physically and mentally using isolation, cramped cells, intense rules, rigid discipline, and crushing punishment.
sentences.zh: 顽固的职业罪犯通过孤立、狭窄的牢房、严苛的规则、严格的纪律和严厉的惩罚，在身心两方面被剥夺人性并彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: Some prisoners reported being threatened and beaten by guards.
sentences.zh: 一些囚犯报告说遭到狱警的威胁和殴打。

sentences.en: Others claimed to have been chained down in the old dungeons beneath the cell house as punishment.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则声称作为惩罚，他们曾被锁在监舍地下的旧地牢里。

sentences.en: In the initial years of the prison, a strict rule of silence was enforced, meaning prisoners were not permitted to talk to one another except during meal and recreation periods.
sentences.zh: 在监狱的最初几年，实行了严格的禁言令，这意味着囚犯除了在用餐和娱乐时间外，不准互相交谈。

sentences.en: Prisoners who violated the silence rule were disciplined harshly.
sentences.zh: 违反禁言令的囚犯会受到严厉的纪律处分。

sentences.en: The rule was eventually relaxed when prison operators realised that sent many prisoners insane after an inmate chopped off four of his
sentences.zh: 当监狱管理者意识到这一规定导致许多囚犯精神失常后，最终放宽了规定。此前曾有一名囚犯用斧头砍掉了自己的四根

sentences.en: fingers with a hatchet in a desperate attempt to get off the island.
sentences.zh: 手指，拼死想要逃离这座岛屿。

sentences.en: Inmates nicknamed the island
sentences.zh: 囚犯们给这座岛取了个外号叫

sentences.en: Helcatraz and marched about the cold island with hopeless and helpless despair, tortured daily by the cheerful sights and sounds of bustling San Francisco city across the bay.
sentences.zh: 地狱魔岛，带着绝望与无助的情绪在这个寒冷的岛屿上列队行进，海湾对岸繁华的旧金山市那欢快的景象和声音每天都在折磨着他们。

sentences.en: San Francisco residents were wary of having a prison crowded with the most dangerous criminals in America, located in the heart of their harbour.
sentences.zh: 旧金山居民对于在他们的港口正中心关押着全美最危险罪犯的监狱感到担忧。

sentences.en: Alcatraz prison operators assured them that their one-of-a-kind, state-of-the-art island prison was completely escape-proof.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱的管理者向他们保证，这座独一无二、最先进的海岛监狱是绝对插翅难飞的。

sentences.en: The prison was fitted with an abundance of safeguards to keep prisoners in, but it didn't stop some inmates from trying to plot their escape.
sentences.zh: 监狱配备了大量的安保措施来把囚犯关在里面，但这并没有阻止一些囚犯图谋越狱。

sentences.en: By 1946, there had been nine escape attempts from Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 到1946年，恶魔岛已经发生了九起越狱未遂事件。

sentences.en: Fences were climbed, iron bars were filed through, rafts were constructed.
sentences.zh: 翻越栅栏、锯断铁条、制作木筏。

sentences.en: Desperate escapees viciously killed a guard using a hammer.
sentences.zh: 绝望的越狱者用锤子残忍地杀害了一名狱警。

sentences.en: Some inmates slipped away during momentary distractions.
sentences.zh: 一些囚犯趁着短暂的注意力分散悄悄溜走。

sentences.en: Impressively, one inmate was able to assemble a US Army sergeant's uniform from bags of laundry and when wearing the uniform, snuck aboard a ferry off the island.
sentences.zh: 令人印象深刻的是，一名囚犯能够用洗衣袋拼凑出一套美军中士制服，穿上制服后，溜上了一艘离开该岛的渡轮。

sentences.en: Three inmates were shot dead, two drowned in the strong tides of San Francisco Bay, and those who were recaptured wound up in solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 三名囚犯被开枪击毙，两人在旧金山湾湍急的潮水中溺水身亡，而那些被重新抓获的人则被关进了单人禁闭室。

sentences.en: Of the 22 inmates who had attempted to break out of Alcatraz, all so far had failed.
sentences.zh: 在22名试图逃离恶魔岛的囚犯中，到目前为止全部失败了。

sentences.en: 37-year-old Bernie Coy was sentenced in June 1937 to serve 25 years for armed robbery at a penitentiary in Atlanta, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 37岁的伯尼·科伊于1937年6月被判在佐治亚州亚特兰大的一所监狱因持械抢劫服刑25年。

sentences.en: A World War I veteran who struggled to find employment after the war, Coy took to robbing banks to make quick cash.
sentences.zh: 作为一名第一次世界大战老兵，战后难以找到工作，科伊开始抢劫银行以赚取快钱。

sentences.en: After his trial,
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，

sentences.en: Coy told the judge, there's no place you can send me that will hold me.
sentences.zh: 科伊对法官说：“你们找不到任何能关住我的地方。”

sentences.en: Born into poverty and the target of his father's beatings, prison nurtured Coy's defensive and violent tendencies and he frequently got into confrontations with other inmates.
sentences.zh: 出生于贫困之中并屡遭父亲殴打，监狱培养了科伊防范和暴力的倾向，他经常与其他囚犯发生冲突。

sentences.en: When Coy attached a razor blade to a toothbrush handle and attacked another inmate with it, prison authorities decided that without
sentences.zh: 当科伊将剃须刀片绑在牙刷柄上并以此袭击另一名囚犯时，监狱当局认为，如果不加以

sentences.en: stricter control and punishment, Bernie Coy could become a dangerous, high-risk inmate.
sentences.zh: 更严格的管制和惩罚，伯尼·科伊可能会成为一个危险的高风险犯人。

sentences.en: In July 1937, only 28 days into his 25-year sentence, Coy was transferred to Alcatraz
sentences.zh: 1937年7月，在25年刑期仅过去28天时，科伊被转入恶魔岛

sentences.en: Prison, where it was believed the harsher environment would straighten him out.
sentences.zh: 监狱，人们相信更严厉的环境能让他改邪归正。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy became Alcatraz Inmate AZ-415.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊成为了恶魔岛AZ-415号囚犯。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy despised Alcatraz Prison.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊鄙视恶魔岛监狱。

sentences.en: He routinely fought other inmates, including one violent fight where he was stabbed with a butcher's knife multiple times.
sentences.zh: 他经常与其他囚犯打架，其中有一次激烈的斗殴中，他多次被屠夫刀刺伤。

sentences.en: Coy spent seven days in the prison hospital recovering.
sentences.zh: 科伊在监狱医院度过了七天进行康复。

sentences.en: The life-threatening experience should have taught him a valuable lesson.
sentences.zh: 这次生死攸关的经历本该给他上一课宝贵的经验。

sentences.en: Only those who put their head down, shut up, and served their time would come out of Alcatraz alive.
sentences.zh: 只有那些低头不语、闭嘴服刑的人才能活着离开恶魔岛。

sentences.en: But it was hard to break a man who was already broken.
sentences.zh: 但要击垮一个已经心死的人是很难的。

sentences.en: At the end of 1939, during his second year on Alcatraz, Bernie Coy attempted to escape by trying to cut through a steel window shield located in the prison's bake shop.
sentences.zh: 1939年底，在恶魔岛的第二年，伯尼·科伊试图通过锯断监狱面包房的一块钢制窗挡来逃跑。

sentences.en: His plan was thwarted, and to try and discourage any further escape attempts, he was given the worst and most feared punishment a prisoner could receive on Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 他的计划破产了，为了阻止任何进一步的越狱企图，他受到了囚犯在恶魔岛上所能接受的最糟糕、最可怕的惩罚。

sentences.en: Time in the strip cell.
sentences.zh: 关入小黑屋（strip cell）。

sentences.en: The strip cell was located in D Block, known as the prison's treatment unit, a prison within a prison.
sentences.zh: 小黑屋位于D监区，这里被称为监狱的惩戒区，是监狱中的监狱。

sentences.en: D Block was a self-contained section in the southern area of the main cell house, inaccessible and off-limits to general population inmates.
sentences.zh: D监区是主监舍南部的一个独立区域，普通监区的犯人无法进入且严禁入内。

sentences.en: D Block featured
sentences.zh: D监区设有

sentences.en: 42 cells, home to Alcatraz's most problematic and dangerous rule breakers.
sentences.zh: 42间牢房，关押着恶魔岛最成问题、最危险的违规者。

sentences.en: 36 were solitary confinement cells.
sentences.zh: 其中36间是单人禁闭室。

sentences.en: Prisoners in solitary were kept in their cells at all times except for one visit to the recreation yard and two trips to the shower facilities per week.
sentences.zh: 关禁闭的囚犯除了每周去一次娱乐场和两次去淋浴设施外，其余时间都必须待在牢房里。

sentences.en: Five were isolation cells.
sentences.zh: 其中5间是隔离室。

sentences.en: They had dual doors, a traditional barred door and a heavy steel door in front to completely entomb the inmate inside.
sentences.zh: 它们有双层门，一扇传统的铁条门和前面一扇厚重的钢门，以便将囚犯完全封闭在里面。

sentences.en: These cells were nicknamed the hole, and only contained a sink, toilet, and a low wattage light bulb.
sentences.zh: 这些牢房被称为“洞穴”，里面只有一个洗手台、一个马桶和一个低瓦数的灯泡。

sentences.en: After his attempted bake shop breakout,
sentences.zh: 在他试图通过面包房越狱失败后，

sentences.en: Bernie Coy was put in the strip cell, the final cell at the end of the isolation cells.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊被关进了小黑屋，即隔离室尽头的最后一间牢房。

sentences.en: Prior to entry, inmates were stripped naked and pushed into the cold, steel-encased cell with no clothing or blankets.
sentences.zh: 入内前，囚犯会被剥光衣服，推进冰冷的、四周是钢板的牢房里，没有衣服或毯子。

sentences.en: There was nothing inside but a hole in the floor used as a toilet.
sentences.zh: 里面空无一物，只有一个用作马桶的地漏孔。

sentences.en: The strip cell also featured dual doors, except its solid door remained closed at all times, keeping the cell in complete darkness.
sentences.zh: 小黑屋同样配有双层门，但其坚固的门始终处于关闭状态，使牢房陷入完全黑暗之中。

sentences.en: A flimsy mattress was slid in at night but taken away during the day.
sentences.zh: 夜间会塞进一张薄薄的床垫，但白天会被拿走。

sentences.en: Inmates in the strip cell were also given a restricted diet of bread and water.
sentences.zh: 关在小黑屋里的囚犯还被给予只有面包和水的限量饮食。

sentences.en: The extreme coldness, isolation, hunger and sensory deprivation had a profound effect on prisoners kept inside.
sentences.zh: 极度的寒冷、隔离、饥饿和感官剥夺对被关在里面的囚犯产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: The strip cell broke the most disobedient prisoners into a weakened state of obedience.
sentences.zh: 小黑屋将最不听话的囚犯摧毁至一种虚弱顺从的状态。

sentences.en: And in the case of Bernie Coy, it appeared to have worked.
sentences.zh: 就伯尼·科伊而言，这似乎起作用了。

sentences.en: After his time in the strip cell, Bernie Coy emerged a changed man.
sentences.zh: 在小黑屋度过一段时间后，伯尼·科伊出来时判若两人。

sentences.en: He was far less antagonistic and appeared to have given up any plans to escape.
sentences.zh: 他温和了许多，并且似乎已经放弃了任何越狱的计划。

sentences.en: Over the following seven years, Bernie Coy earned a new reputation as a mature, easygoing, respectful inmate who got on well with everyone.
sentences.zh: 在随后的七年里，伯尼·科伊赢得了一个新名声，即一个成熟、随和、懂礼貌、与所有人都能融洽相处的模范囚犯。

sentences.en: He was well-liked and trusted by fellow inmates and prison guards alike.
sentences.zh: 他深受同监犯人和狱警的喜爱与信任。

sentences.en: Coy's positive reputation earned him the coveted job as the prison's library orderly.
sentences.zh: 科伊良好的声誉为他赢得了令人艳羡的工作——监狱图书馆杂工。

sentences.en: The Alcatraz Library was in the main cell house in the southeast corner of the building, adjacent to C Block and a next door to D Block.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛图书馆位于主监舍东南部角落，毗邻C监区，与D监区仅一墙之隔。

sentences.en: A job given to trusted prisoners, the library orderly was permitted to move freely around the prison cell house to deliver reading material to guards and inmates.
sentences.zh: 这是一项交给受信任囚犯的工作，图书馆杂工被允许在监狱监舍内自由活动，为狱警和犯人分发阅读材料。

sentences.en: This job granted Bernie
sentences.zh: 这项工作赋予了伯尼·

sentences.en: Coy access to the off-limits and sealed off D Block.
sentences.zh: 科伊进入禁止通行且封闭的D监区的权限。

sentences.en: Through his book deliveries to D Block,
sentences.zh: 通过向D监区送书，

sentences.en: Coy was able to have unsupervised interactions with the prisoners kept there.
sentences.zh: 科伊得以与被关在那里的囚犯进行无人监督的互动。

sentences.en: Viewed as a model inmate, Coy was also given the additional work role of prison orderly, performing general janitorial duties throughout the cell house.
sentences.zh: 由于被视为模范犯人，科伊还被赋予了额外的监狱杂工工作职责，在整个监舍内执行一般清洁任务。

sentences.en: In Alcatraz, being given more work was seen as a privilege, as it meant spending less time alone in your cell.
sentences.zh: 在恶魔岛，被分配更多的工作被视为一种特权，因为这意味着花在独自待在牢房里的时间变少了。

sentences.en: By 1946, Coy was dieting to lose excess weight and spent his spare time performing strength exercises to build muscle.
sentences.zh: 到1946年，科伊正在节食以减掉多余的体重，并利用业余时间进行力量锻炼以增加肌肉。

sentences.en: In total, he lost 20 pounds and became noticeably lean and physically fit.
sentences.zh: 他总共减掉了20磅，体型变得明显消瘦且身体健壮。

sentences.en: Coy read extensively and painted pictures from memory of the hills and valleys from his childhood home of Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 科伊广泛阅读，并凭记忆画出了他童年家乡肯塔基州的山丘和山谷的画作。

sentences.en: Coy's art was even admired by the prison warden who was pleased to put his work in an exhibition in Washington DC where it was positively received.
sentences.zh: 科伊的艺术甚至受到了监狱长的赞赏，监狱长很高兴将他的作品放在华盛顿特区的一个展览上展出，并得到了正面的反响。

sentences.en: It appeared Coy was the shining example of the positive effect the strictness of Alcatraz could have on a difficult and disobedient man.
sentences.zh: 科伊似乎成了恶魔岛的严厉对一个顽固不化、不服管教的人所能产生的积极影响的光辉典范。

sentences.en: Reshaping his reputation, body and mind, Coy went through a multitude of changes.
sentences.zh: 重塑了自己的名誉、身体和心灵，科伊经历了重重蜕变。

sentences.en: But one thing never changed with Bernie Coy.
sentences.zh: 但有一件事在伯尼·科伊身上从未改变。

sentences.en: He was determined more than ever to successfully break out of Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 他比以往任何时候都更加坚决地要成功逃出恶魔岛。

sentences.en: For seven years he had behaved himself and earned everyone's trust, patiently and discreetly studying the prison and its guards, memorising their schedules,
sentences.zh: 七年来，他一直循规蹈矩，赢得了所有人的信任，耐心而谨慎地研究监狱及其狱警，熟记他们的时间表、

sentences.en: interactions work duties and habits he called in favors from other inmates procured and smuggled
sentences.zh: 互动、工作职责和习惯；他向其他囚犯求助、获取并走私

sentences.en: Most cells were empty, as the majority of the general prison population were out working in other areas of the island.
sentences.zh: 大多数牢房都是空的，因为绝大多数普通犯人都在岛上的其他区域劳作。

sentences.en: By 1.30pm, the guard presence in the main cell house was at its lowest level.
sentences.zh: 到下午1点30分，主监舍内的狱警人数降到了最低水平。

sentences.en: The only guards on watch at the time were Correctional Officers Bert Birch and William Miller.
sentences.zh: 当时仅有的值班狱警是管教员伯特·伯奇和威廉·米勒。

sentences.en: Birch paced the West End gun gallery with rifle in hand.
sentences.zh: 伯奇手持步枪在西区枪廊来回踱步。

sentences.en: The gallery was an elevated barred catwalk that ran the length of the western wall above the ground floor.
sentences.zh: 枪廊是一条高架的带栏杆的猫道，沿地面层上方的西墙延伸。

sentences.en: Its high vantage point enabled the guard a top-down view of the entire cell house.
sentences.zh: 其高处的视野使警卫能够俯瞰整个监舍。

sentences.en: Officer Miller sat at the guard's desk by the dining hall entrance underneath the gallery.
sentences.zh: 米勒警官坐在枪廊下方餐厅入口旁的警卫桌旁。

sentences.en: Coy continued sweeping the floor steadily by the desk, keeping his head down.
sentences.zh: 科伊继续低着头在桌子旁平稳地扫地。

sentences.en: Once he turned to the corner of C Block and was out of Birch and Miller's sights, Coy rushed to the library.
sentences.zh: 一旦他转到C监区的拐角处，脱离了伯奇和米勒的视线，科伊便冲向图书馆。

sentences.en: At the back of the library was a door that led to D Block, which he tapped on several times.

sentences.zh: 恶魔岛AZ-462号囚犯、39岁的萨姆·肖克利耳中。

sentences.en: Shockley was serving a life sentence for bank robbery and kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 肖克利因银行劫匪和绑架罪被判无期徒刑。

sentences.en: Shockley had the mental development equivalent of a child aged 8 to 10 years old, and he suffered from schizophrenia and hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 肖克利的智力发育相当于8到10岁的儿童，他患有精神分裂症和幻觉。

sentences.en: He spoke of hearing radio voices that stayed on all night, frightening him as they spoke evil words.
sentences.zh: 他谈到听到整夜不息的广播声音，这些声音说着邪恶的话语，令他感到恐惧。

sentences.en: He believed his food was drugged to make him crazy, that he had stomach cancer, which he didn't.
sentences.zh: 他相信自己的食物被下了药以使他发疯，还认为自己患有胃癌，而实际上并没有。

sentences.en: And he said he saw flashing beams of light in his cell at night that he thought controlled him.
sentences.zh: 并且他说他晚上在牢房里看到闪烁的光束，认为那是用来控制他的。

sentences.en: His psychosis resulted in violent and uncontrollable rages that earned him the nickname Crazy Sam, and he was considered far
sentences.zh: 他的精神病导致了暴力且无法控制的暴怒，这为他赢得了“疯子萨姆”的外号，他被认为

sentences.en: too dangerous for regular prison, so he was quickly transferred to Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 对普通监狱来说过于危险，因此很快被转到了恶魔岛。

sentences.en: However, Alcatraz didn't fixed Shockley.
sentences.zh: 然而，恶魔岛并没有治好肖克利。

sentences.en: He continued to have psychotic meltdowns where he would scream threats, throw things from his cell, break plumbing fixtures, start fires, and attack officers.
sentences.zh: 他继续发作精神病，尖叫着发出威胁、从牢房里扔东西、砸坏水管设备、纵火并袭击警官。

sentences.en: As a result, he spent most of his time in D-block solitary, and he was often put in the strip cell.
sentences.zh: 因此，他大部分时间都在D监区的单人禁闭室度过，并且经常被关进小黑屋。

sentences.en: When
sentences.zh: 当

sentences.zh: 肖克利听到科伊在图书馆门上的敲击声时，他清楚该怎么做。

sentences.en: Crazy Sam suddenly erupted into a pre-planned and staged violent rage that mimicked his previous meltdowns.
sentences.zh: 疯子萨姆突然爆发出一场事先计划好并假装的暴力狂怒，模仿了他先前的精神发作。

sentences.zh: 值班的科尔文警官来说，看到肖克利无缘无故地情绪爆发并不罕见。

sentences.en: to step into the D block gallery and oversee the situation as backup back in the main cell house
sentences.zh: 在科尔文前去调查之前，他打电话给主监舍枪廊的伯奇警官，

sentences.en: Bernie Coy continued sweeping the corridors pretending to be oblivious to the commotion he had just caused in D-Block.
sentences.zh: 要求他步入D监区枪廊并作为后援监督情况。回到主监舍，

sentences.en: With his eyes set on Officer Birch up in the gallery
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊继续清扫走廊，假装对自己在D监区刚刚引起的骚动浑然不知。

sentences.en: Coy watched as he took a telephone call and quickly headed to the door leading to the D-Block gallery.
sentences.zh: 他将目光锁定在枪廊上的伯奇警官身上，看着他接听了电话并迅速走向通往D监区枪廊的门。

sentences.en: Everything was going exactly to plan.

sentences.en: Coy swept his broom towards the entrance of the dining hall ready for the next part of his elaborate plan.
sentences.zh: 科伊将扫帚扫向餐厅入口，准备实施他精心策划的下一步计划。

sentences.en: Alcatraz inmate AZ645 was 34-year-old Marvin Hubbard, a convicted armed robber imprisoned in 1942 for kidnapping and transporting firearms across state lines.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卡特拉兹监狱的AZ645号犯人是34岁的马文·哈伯德，他是一名被判刑的武装抢劫犯，于1942年因绑架和跨州运送枪支入狱。

sentences.en: Hubbard was sent to Alcatraz after instigating riots and attempting several escapes at his previous prison.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德在之前的监狱中煽动暴乱并多次企图越狱，因此被送到了阿尔卡特拉兹。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of May 2nd 1946, Hubbard was on clean-up duty in the prison's kitchen, located at the back of the dining hall.
sentences.zh: 1946年5月2日下午，哈伯德在位于餐厅后方的监狱厨房值清洁班。

sentences.en: Intentionally working slower than usual, Hubbard had been waiting for his signal from Bernie Coy to let him know the escape was on.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德故意放慢工作速度，一直在等待伯尼·科伊发出的越狱开始的信号。

sentences.en: Hubbard caught sight of Coy in the main cell house and got the signal.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德在主监舍看到了科伊，并收到了信号。

sentences.en: He discreetly slipped the large butcher's knife up his shirt sleeve.
sentences.zh: 他不动声色地将一把大号屠刀塞进衬衫袖子里。

sentences.en: Keeping the handle in his palm, he moved towards the guard supervising the kitchen cleaning crew, Officer Joseph Burdett.
sentences.zh: 他将刀柄握在手心，走向负责监督厨房清洁组的警官约瑟夫·伯德特。

sentences.en: At 1.40pm, Hubbard asked Burdett if he could go to the recreation yard and get some fresh air.
sentences.zh: 下午1点40分，哈伯德问伯德特他是否可以去娱乐场呼吸一下新鲜空气。

sentences.en: Burdett agreed, and Hubbard walked down the long dining hall to the barred gate leading into the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 伯德特同意了，于是哈伯德沿着长长的餐厅走向通往主监舍的带栅栏的大门。

sentences.en: Officer Miller was now the only guard in the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 此时米勒警官是主监舍里唯一的警卫。

sentences.en: He was by the entrance to the dining hall when Hubbard appeared.
sentences.zh: 当哈伯德出现时，他正站在餐厅入口附近。

sentences.en: Miller opened the gate to let Hubbard into the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 米勒打开大门，让哈伯德进入主监舍。

sentences.en: Hubbard lifted his arms in preparation to be patted down by Miller to check if he had smuggled any contraband from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德举起双臂，准备接受米勒的搜身，以检查他是否从厨房夹带了违禁品。

sentences.en: Hubbard eyed Bernie Coy.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德注视着伯尼·科伊。

sentences.en: Now was his chance.
sentences.zh: 机会来了。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy silently placed the broom down, lulled himself into a crouch, and crept up behind Miller as the guard was patting Hubbard down.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊默默地放下扫帚，躬下身子，趁米勒警官给哈伯德搜身时，悄悄摸到了米勒身后。

sentences.en: Miller had no idea Coy had snuck up behind him until he was punched in the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 直到后脑勺挨了一拳，米勒才知道科伊已经悄悄摸到了他身后。

sentences.en: Coy then pinned Miller's arms from behind, allowing Hubbard to attack him with a flurry of violent punches.
sentences.zh: 接着，科伊从后面抱住米勒的双臂，让哈伯德对其一阵猛烈殴打。

sentences.en: Officer Miller, battered and bleeding, slumped back against Coy, unconscious.
sentences.zh: 米勒警官被打得遍体鳞伤、血迹斑斑，不省人事地倒在科伊身上。

sentences.en: Coy searched Miller's body and stole a large ring of keys clipped to his belt.
sentences.zh: 科伊搜了米勒的身，偷走了挂在他皮带上的一大串钥匙。

sentences.en: After years of spying on the prison, Coy had the knowledge to access and use the control panel that opened and closed the prison cells.
sentences.zh: 经过多年对监狱的摸底，科伊掌握了如何使用控制面板来开闭监狱牢房的知识。

sentences.en: He pulled a lever and racked open an empty cell on the corner of C Block, cell number 404.
sentences.zh: 他拉动一个杠杆，拉开了C区角落里一间空牢房，即404号牢房。

sentences.en: Coy and Hubbard dragged Miller inside the cell, stripped him of his uniform jacket and pants and then tied him down to the cell bunk.
sentences.zh: 科伊和哈伯德把米勒拖进牢房，扒掉他的制服夹克和裤子，然后把他绑在牢房的铺位上。

sentences.en: Coy ran back to the control box and opened three more specific cells.
sentences.zh: 科伊跑回控制箱，又打开了另外三间特定的牢房。

sentences.zh: 案卷档案稍后回归。

sentences.en: From the first cell emerged Alcatraz inmate AZ-548, 35-year-old Joseph Kretzer, a bank robber sentenced to serve 25 years in February 1940.
sentences.zh: 从第一间牢房里走出来的是阿尔卡特拉兹AZ-548号犯人，35岁的约瑟夫·克雷特泽，他是一名于1940年2月被判处25年监禁的银行抢劫犯。

sentences.en: During outdoor work at McNeil Island Corrections Centre in Washington, Kretzer and another inmate armed themselves with axes, stole a prison truck,
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿麦克尼尔岛惩教中心的户外劳动期间，克雷特泽和另一名囚犯用斧头武装自己，偷了一辆监狱卡车，

sentences.en: and drove to a remote area where they were on the run for three days before being recaptured.
sentences.zh: 并开车逃到一个偏远地区，在被重新抓获之前逃亡了三天。

sentences.en: The two were put on trial for unlawful escape.
sentences.zh: 两人因非法越狱被提起诉讼。

sentences.en: When the court took a recess at noon, Kretzer and his co-accused were led to a detention cell.
sentences.zh: 当法院在中午休庭时，克雷特泽和他的同案被告被带到了一间拘留室。

sentences.en: When court recommenced, two court marshals entered the cell to retrieve the two accused.
sentences.zh: 庭审恢复时，两名法警进入拘留室带这两名被告。

sentences.en: Kretzer stood and charged at the marshals in an attempt to escape, and a violent altercation followed.
sentences.zh: 克雷特泽起身冲向法警企图越狱，随后爆发了激烈的冲突。

sentences.en: After the scuffle, one of the marshals fell to the floor and suffered a fatal heart attack.
sentences.zh: 冲突过后，其中一名法警倒在地上，突发心脏病身亡。

sentences.en: In the trial that followed, the court accepted that death was accidental, so Joseph Kretzer avoided the electric chair, but was handed a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 在随后的审判中，法庭认定死亡属于意外，因此约瑟夫·克雷特泽避免了电椅死刑，但被判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: Due to his history, it was determined that greater measures were needed to contain Joseph Kretzer, and he was sent to live out his life sentence at Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的过往记录，法庭认为需要采取更严厉的措施来关押约瑟夫·克雷特泽，于是他被送到阿尔卡特拉兹度过余生。

sentences.en: From the next cell emerged Alcatraz inmate AZ-729, 30-year-old Niren Thompson.
sentences.zh: 从下一间牢房走出来的是阿尔卡特拉兹AZ-729号犯人，30岁的尼伦·汤普森。

sentences.en: Thompson had a long and varied criminal history, and in March 1945, he committed the act that would see him sealed away for good.
sentences.zh: 汤普森有着漫长而复杂的犯罪历史，1945年3月，他犯下了一项将让他永远被囚禁的罪行。

sentences.en: Thompson was being apprehended for his involvement in a burglary.
sentences.zh: 汤普森当时因涉嫌入室盗窃而被捕。

sentences.en: He had not yet been handcuffed, so when the opportunity arose, Thompson pulled out a concealed revolver, pointed it at his arresting officer, and fired.
sentences.zh: 他当时还没戴上手铐，因此一有机会，汤普森就掏出一把藏好的左轮手枪，对准逮捕他的警官开枪。

sentences.en: The officer died instantly.
sentences.zh: 这名警官当场身亡。

sentences.en: Thompson fled to New Mexico and was captured attempting to cross the border.
sentences.zh: 汤普森逃往新墨西哥州，在企图越境时被捕。

sentences.en: Alcatraz was the best incarceration option for Thompson.
sentences.zh: 对汤普森来说，阿尔卡特拉兹是最佳的关押地点。

sentences.en: Its thick concrete walls and tool-resistant bars would hold this slick criminal who had eight successful prison escapes noted on his record.
sentences.zh: 这里厚实的混凝土墙和无法用工具破坏的铁栏杆，能够关住这个有八次成功越狱记录的狡猾罪犯。

sentences.en: Thompson had only been in Alcatraz for just over six months when his cell door rattled open and he stepped out to play his part in Bernie Coy's escape plan.
sentences.zh: 汤普森被关进阿尔卡特拉兹才刚刚六个多月，他的牢房门就哗啦一声打开了，他走了出来，准备在伯尼·科伊的越狱计划中扮演他的角色。

sentences.en: From the third and final cell emerged Alcatraz inmate AZ-714, 18-year-old Clarence Carnes,
sentences.zh: 从第三间也是最后一间牢房里走出来的是阿尔卡特拉兹AZ-714号犯人，18岁的克拉伦斯·卡恩斯。

sentences.en: Carnes was sentenced to life imprisonment at the age of 16 for the murder of a garage attendant during an attempted hold-up.
sentences.zh: 卡恩斯因在一次未遂抢劫中谋杀了一名车库服务员，在16岁时被判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: He escaped in 1945 but was recaptured and had 99 years added to his life sentence.
sentences.zh: 他在1945年越狱，但被重新抓获，无期徒刑被加刑99年。

sentences.en: After making another escape attempt shortly after, Carnes was transferred to
sentences.zh: 不久后又一次企图越狱后，卡恩斯被转移到了

sentences.en: Escape Proof Alcatraz in June 1945, where he earned the record of being the youngest inmate to ever be incarcerated there.
sentences.zh: 号称“越狱无门”的阿尔卡特拉兹，时间是1945年6月，他在那里创下了被关押囚犯中年龄最小的纪录。

sentences.en: At this stage, prison staff were completely unaware that a group of prisoners were orchestrating a breakout.
sentences.zh: 此时，监狱工作人员完全不知道有一群囚犯正在密谋越狱。

sentences.en: As his accomplices kept looking out at the cell house entrances, Bernie Coy squeezed into the narrow utility corridor in the centre of C Block.
sentences.zh: 当同伙们继续注视着监舍入口时，伯尼·科伊挤进了C区中心狭窄的杂物走廊。

sentences.en: In the narrow hallway of pipes, Coy collected the cotton pouch he had hidden there long before.
sentences.zh: 在长满管道的狭窄走廊里，科伊找到了他很久以前藏在那里的棉布袋。

sentences.en: Inside the pouch were several items Coy had smuggled and prepared earlier, a bar spreading device constructed out of toilet fixtures, a wrench and axle grease.
sentences.zh: 袋子里装着科伊提前走私并准备好的几样东西：一个用马桶配件改装的撑杆器、一把扳手和轴承脂。

sentences.en: Coy stripped to his underwear and smeared the grease all over his body.
sentences.zh: 科伊脱得只剩内裤，把润滑脂抹遍全身。

sentences.en: Holding the pouch between clenched teeth, Coy hoisted himself up and took hold of the bar surrounding the cell house observation point, the West End gun gallery.
sentences.zh: 科伊用牙齿紧紧咬住布袋，把自己拉上去，抓住环绕监舍观测点（即西端枪支走廊）的铁栏杆。

sentences.en: Hand over hand he scaled the bars until he was on top, looking down into the gallery's catwalk.
sentences.zh: 他手脚并用地顺着栏杆往上爬，直到爬上顶端，俯视着走廊的猫道。

sentences.en: Coy needed to move quickly,
sentences.zh: 科伊需要迅速行动，

sentences.en: Officer Birch was still distracted in D-block overseeing Shockley's staged meltdown, but he could return at any moment.
sentences.zh: 伯奇警官当时仍在D区监督绍克利自导自演的精神崩溃，但随时可能返回。

sentences.en: Coy manoeuvred the bar spreading tool into the 5-inch gap between the bars.
sentences.zh: 科伊将撑杆工具塞进栏杆之间5英寸的缝隙中。

sentences.en: Using a tight grip on the wrench, he rotated the bar spreader, causing enough tension for the bars to slowly bend.
sentences.zh: 他紧紧握住扳手转动撑杆器，产生足够的张力使栏杆慢慢弯曲。

sentences.en: With several strained turns of the wrench,
sentences.zh: 经过扳手几次费力的旋转，

sentences.en: Coy forced the 5-inch gap between the bars into a sizable 10-inch gap.
sentences.zh: 科伊硬生生地把栏杆间5英寸的缝隙撑成了一个足有10英寸宽的大豁口。

sentences.en: Having already lost 20 pounds of body weight in preparation for this moment, Coy inhaled a deep breath and squeezed his lean frame into the opening.
sentences.zh: 为了这一刻，他已经减掉了20磅的体重，此刻他深吸一口气，将精瘦的身躯挤进了开口处。

sentences.en: The grease helped slide his body through, and within seconds,
sentences.zh: 润滑脂帮他的身体滑了过去，几秒钟内，

sentences.en: Coy dropped down into the gallery.
sentences.zh: 科伊就落入了走廊内。

sentences.en: Excitedly rummaging through the weapons cabinet, Coy armed himself with a riot club and ducked by the door that led to the D-block gallery.
sentences.zh: 科伊兴奋地翻找着武器柜，拿了一根防暴棍武装自己，并蹲在通往D区走廊的门旁。

sentences.en: When Officer Birch re-entered the main cell house gallery after helping deal with Shockley,
sentences.zh: 当伯奇警官处理完绍克利的事重新进入主监舍走廊时，

sentences.en: Coy pounced.
sentences.zh: 科伊猛扑了过去。

sentences.en: He violently thumped the officer with the riot club, throwing the guard off balance and causing him to drop his rifle.
sentences.zh: 他用防暴棍狠狠地击打这位警官，使其失去平衡并丢下了步枪。

sentences.en: Coy leapt on top of him and began to strangle him.
sentences.zh: 科伊扑到他身上开始勒他的脖子。

sentences.en: Officer Birch's eyes rolled back and his body went limp.
sentences.zh: 伯奇警官双眼翻白，身体瘫软下来。

sentences.en: Coy released the unconscious guard and took more items from the gallery's weapon cabinet.
sentences.zh: 科伊放开了昏迷的警卫，从走廊的武器柜里拿了更多装备。

sentences.en: He lowered a Colt .45 pistol with 21 rounds of ammunition and several riot clubs to Kretzer and the others on the ground floor.
sentences.zh: 他将一支带21发子弹的柯尔特.45手枪和几根防暴棍递给地面的克雷特泽等人。

sentences.en: Coy took ownership of Officer Birch's rifle and 50 rounds of ammunition.
sentences.zh: 科伊拿走了伯奇警官的步枪和50发子弹。

sentences.en: With rifle in hand, Coy opened the door to the D-block gallery and snuck in.
sentences.zh: 科伊手握步枪，打开通往D区走廊的门潜了进去。

sentences.en: Officer Corwin heard movement in the gallery above, assuming Officer Birch had come back.
sentences.zh: 科温警官听到上方走廊有动静，以为是伯奇警官回来了。

sentences.en: But when he looked up, he saw Bernie Coy pointing a rifle down at him.
sentences.zh: 但当他抬头时，看到的是伯尼·科伊正拿着步枪指着他。

sentences.en: Coy told Officer Corwin to follow his orders, stay away from the telephone, walk over to the door and open it.
sentences.zh: 科伊命令科温警官听从指挥，远离电话，走到门前并把门打开。

sentences.en: Coy kept the rifle trained on Officer Corwin as he unlocked the ground floor door to the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 科伊用步枪瞄准科温警官，同时他打开了通往主监舍的一楼大门。

sentences.en: The door swung open and Kretzer was waiting, immediately pressing the barrel of his pistol against Corwin's forehead.
sentences.zh: 门应声而开，克雷特泽正等在那里，立刻把手枪枪管顶在科温的额头上。

sentences.en: Kretzer ordered him to hand over his uniform jacket, hat, and keys.
sentences.zh: 克雷特泽命令他交出制服夹克、帽子和钥匙。

sentences.en: Corwin was then forced into cell 404, where Officer Miller was imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 随后，科温被强行推进关押着米勒警官的404号牢房。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy returned to Officer Birch, stripped the unconscious officer of his uniform, stole his keys, and tied him against some electrical piping.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊回到伯奇警官身边，扒下这位昏迷警官的制服，偷走他的钥匙，并把他绑在一些电线管道上。

sentences.en: Coy then squeezed through the bent bars above and climbed back down to the ground floor.
sentences.zh: 接着，科伊从上面弯曲的栏杆挤过去，爬回了一楼。

sentences.en: When Officer Birch regained consciousness, he struggled with his restraints and eyed the telephone nearby.
sentences.zh: 当伯奇警官恢复意识时，他挣扎着想要挣脱束缚，并把目光投向了附近的电话。

sentences.en: I'll kill you if you try to reach that phone, Kretzer warned, pointing his pistol up at the guard.
sentences.zh: “你要是敢去拿那个电话，我就杀了你，”克雷特泽举枪指着警卫警告道。

sentences.en: At the control box, Koi racked open all the cells to the top two levels of D-block.
sentences.zh: 在控制箱旁，科伊拉开了D区顶层两层的所有牢房门。

sentences.en: Some inmates emerged, curious to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 一些囚犯走了出来，好奇地想看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: Others remained in their cells, not wanting to get involved.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则留在牢房里，不想蹚这趟浑水。

sentences.en: Sam Shockley bounded from his trash cell, ready to escape.
sentences.zh: 山姆·绍克利从他的垃圾箱般的牢房里蹦出来，准备越狱。

sentences.en: Koi and
sentences.zh: 科伊和

sentences.en: Kretzer hurriedly inspected the collection of keys they had confiscated from the guards, looking for key number 107.
sentences.zh: 克雷特泽匆忙检查从警卫那里没收来的一堆钥匙，寻找107号钥匙。

sentences.en: From his observations, Koi knew key 107 opened the door to the recreation yard.
sentences.zh: 根据观察，科伊知道107号钥匙能打开通往娱乐场的门。

sentences.en: Once in the yard, the escapees planned to shoot out surrounding guard towers.
sentences.zh: 一旦进入院子，越狱者计划射击周围的岗楼。

sentences.en: They would then make their way to the island docks taking hostages along the way, possibly the family members of prison staff who lived on the island.
sentences.zh: 然后他们将前往岛上的码头，一路劫持人质，可能是住在岛上的监狱员工家属。

sentences.en: Then they'd hijack a boat and set sail to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 接着他们会劫持一艘船，起航前往内地。

sentences.en: To freedom.
sentences.zh: 奔向自由。

sentences.en: However, progress immediately came to a halt when Koi hit the first major hurdle in his meticulous escape plan.
sentences.zh: 然而，当科伊在他缜密的越狱计划中遇到第一个重大坎坷时，进展立刻停滞了。

sentences.en: He didn't have key 107.
sentences.zh: 他没有107号钥匙。

sentences.en: Coy expected to be out of the cell house and into the yard by now, but without key 107, that was impossible, and he didn't have a backup plan.
sentences.zh: 科伊本以为此时已经离开监舍进入院子了，但没有107号钥匙这是不可能的，而且他没有备用计划。

sentences.en: Impatient and frustrated, he began shoving the keys he did have into the lock in a fruitless attempt to open the door, but as to be expected, the door wouldn't open
sentences.zh: 他既急躁又沮丧，开始把手头的钥匙往锁里插，徒劳地试图开门，但不出所料，

sentences.en: without the correct key.
sentences.zh: 没有正确的钥匙，门根本打不开。

sentences.en: Then suddenly, the entry door to the main cell house swung open.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，主监舍的入口大门突然猛地敞开了。

sentences.en: Chief Steward Bob Bristow entered the cell house and moved briskly towards the dining hall at the end of the room.
sentences.zh: 总管家鲍勃·布里斯托走进了监舍，快步走向房间尽头的餐厅。

sentences.en: He noticed Officer Miller was not at his poSt. Then he saw that the dining hall gate had been left open.
sentences.zh: 他发现米勒警官不在岗位上，接着他看到餐厅大门开着。

sentences.en: Bristow felt something wasn't right and made phony motions to appear as though he had forgotten something.
sentences.zh: 布里斯托觉得有些不对劲，便假装自己落下了什么东西。

sentences.en: He turned around and walked quickly back towards the cell house entrance where he had just come from.
sentences.zh: 他转过身，快步走回刚刚进来的监舍入口。

sentences.en: But Clarence Carnes, armed with a sharp pair of artist dividers, intercepted Bristow before he could raise the alarm and led him to cell 404
sentences.zh: 但克拉伦斯·卡恩斯手里拿着一把锋利的绘图规，在布里斯托发出警报前拦住了他，并把他带到了关押着其他被俘警卫的

sentences.en: that was holding the other captured guards.
sentences.zh: 404号牢房。

sentences.en: Koy and Kretzer then approached cell 404.
sentences.zh: 接着，科伊和克雷特泽走近404号牢房。

sentences.en: Officer Miller had regained consciousness and the inmates demanded key 107 from him.
sentences.zh: 米勒警官已经恢复了意识，囚犯们向他索要107号钥匙。

sentences.en: Miller told them that after he was done with the key earlier in his shift, he had followed protocol and returned it to Officer Birch in the gallery.
sentences.zh: 米勒告诉他们，他在值班早些时候用完这把钥匙后，按照规矩把它还给了走廊里的伯奇警官。

sentences.en: He could only assume it was still there.
sentences.zh: 他只能推测钥匙还在那里。

sentences.en: Having already taken Officer Birch's keys, Coy considered the possibility he did in fact have key 107, but failed to notice it in his hasty search.
sentences.zh: 由于已经拿到了伯奇警官的钥匙，科伊考虑到他其实可能真的有107号钥匙，只是在仓促搜查时没注意到。

sentences.en: Laying out all the keys he had collected on the guard's desk, Coy carefully inspected each one, but stopped when the cell house entry door opened once more.
sentences.zh: 科伊将收集到的所有钥匙摆在警卫桌上，仔细检查每一把，但当监舍入口大门再次打开时，他停了下来。

sentences.en: Officer Ernest Largeson had finished his lunch break and he was returning to the cell house.
sentences.zh: 欧内斯特·拉吉森警官午休结束，正返回监舍。

sentences.en: He heard footsteps behind him and turned around.
sentences.zh: 他听到身后有脚步声便转过身去。

sentences.en: A figure walked towards him and as it got closer, Largeson made out it was a shirtless man wearing a pair of officer's uniform pants.
sentences.zh: 一个人影向他走来，随着距离越来越近，拉吉森辨认出那是一个赤着上身、穿着警官制服裤子的男人。

sentences.en: He recognised the figure as inmate Bernie Coy.
sentences.zh: 他认出这个人是囚犯伯尼·科伊。

sentences.en: Coy raised his rifle as the others stripped Largeson of his keys and valuables and shoved him into the now overcrowded cell 404 with the other captured guards.
sentences.zh: 当其他人剥下拉吉森的钥匙和贵重物品并把他推进挤满人的404号牢房（关着其他被俘警卫）时，科伊举起了步枪。

sentences.en: None of the captured guards could work out how Coy managed to infiltrate the gallery and obtain the firearms housed there.
sentences.zh: 被俘的警卫们怎么也想不通，科伊是怎么潜入走廊并弄到里面存放的枪支的。

sentences.en: There were no weapons carried in the main section of the cell house, only up in the gallery, as it was considered the most secure area.
sentences.zh: 监舍主区域内从来不携带武器，只有走廊里才有，因为那里被认为是防范最严密的区域。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy was the first inmate in the history of Alcatraz to get his hands on guns from the gallery.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊是阿尔卡特拉兹历史上第一个从走廊弄到枪支的囚犯。

sentences.en: Minutes later, Officer Burdette, who was still supervising the clean-up in the kitchen, left to inspect the cleanliness of the dining hall.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，仍在监督厨房清洁工作的伯德特警官离开去检查餐厅的清洁情况。

sentences.en: He thought it was odd that the dining hall gate was open and there were no guards in sight.
sentences.zh: 他觉得奇怪的是，餐厅的门开着，而且四周不见一个警卫。

sentences.en: As Burdett went to investigate, he glimpsed Bernie Coy rush paSt. Burdett thought Coy was about to fight another inmate, so he yelled out.
sentences.zh: 正当伯德特前去查看时，他瞥见伯尼·科伊快步走过。伯德特以为科伊要跟另一个囚犯打架，便大喊了一声。

sentences.en: Within seconds, Burdett was captured by the escapees and shoved into cell 404.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，伯德特就被越狱者抓获并推进了404号牢房。

sentences.en: Time was running out.
sentences.zh: 时间所剩无几了。

sentences.en: With each new unexpected hostage, the possibility that someone would come looking for the missing guards increased.
sentences.zh: 每多一个意料之外的人质，有人来找失踪警卫的可能性就增加一分。

sentences.en: But without Key 107, the inmates were stuck in the cell house.
sentences.zh: 但没有107号钥匙，囚犯们就被困在了监舍里。

sentences.en: There was no other way of getting out.
sentences.zh: 没有别的出路了。

sentences.en: As a frustrated Coy paced back and forth, trying to determine the whereabouts of Key 107, the imprisoned guards asked if they could untie
sentences.zh: 正当沮丧的科伊来回踱步、试图确定107号钥匙的下落时，被关押的警卫请求是否可以解开

sentences.en: Officer Miller from the cell cot.
sentences.zh: 牢房床铺上的米勒警官。

sentences.en: Clarence Carnes agreed.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯·卡恩斯同意了。

sentences.en: As Officer Miller was untired, he covertly handed Key 107 to Officer Burdette.
sentences.zh: 在给米勒警官松绑时，他暗中将107号钥匙递给了伯德特警官。

sentences.en: The inmates saw nothing.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们什么也没看到。

sentences.en: The cell was too crowded for them to notice the quick exchange.
sentences.zh: 牢房里太挤了，他们没有注意到这个快速的动作。

sentences.en: In what was nothing more than a random coincidence,
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是一个偶然的巧合，

sentences.en: Officer Miller didn't follow correct prison protocol earlier that day like he said he had.
sentences.zh: 米勒警官那天早些时候并没有像他说的那样遵守监狱规章制度。

sentences.en: He had not yet returned key 107 to the gallery, and instead slipped the key into his shirt pocket with the intention to return it later.
sentences.zh: 他当时还没有把107号钥匙还到走廊里，而是把它塞进了衬衫口袋，打算稍后再还。

sentences.en: He took a risk and lied to the escaping inmates.
sentences.zh: 他冒了险，向越狱的囚犯撒了谎。

sentences.en: He knew they would hurt more people if they got out of the cell house, and Miller didn't want that to happened.
sentences.zh: 他知道如果这帮人逃出监舍会伤害更多人，米勒不希望这种事发生。

sentences.en: Kretzer and Coy had missed the key during their hasty search of Miller when he was unconscious.
sentences.zh: 克雷特泽和科伊在米勒昏迷时仓促搜身，漏掉了这把钥匙。

sentences.en: After having Key 107 passed to him, Officer Burdett snuck to the back of the cell.
sentences.zh: 从米勒那里接过107号钥匙后，伯德特警官悄悄溜到了牢房后面。

sentences.en: As the other guards blocked him from view, he dipped the key into the cell toilet and slid it down the pipe until it was out of sight.
sentences.zh: 趁着其他警卫将他挡在视线之外，他把钥匙浸入牢房的马桶里，然后顺着水管推了进去，直到看不见为止。

sentences.en: Furious and flustered, Bernie Coy now suspected he was being lied to and believed Officer Miller still had Key 107.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊气急败坏、心慌意乱，此时他开始怀疑自己被骗了，并坚信米勒警官身上仍然带着107号钥匙。

sentences.en: He opened cell 404 and roughly grabbed Miller, pulling the injured guard out of the cell.
sentences.zh: 他打开了404号牢房，粗暴地抓住米勒，将这个受伤的警卫从牢房里拉了出来。

sentences.en: Kratzer aggressively searched him again, but found nothing.
sentences.zh: 克拉特泽再次对他的全身进行了粗暴的搜查，但什么也没找到。

sentences.en: They demanded all of the guards in cell 404 out and transferred them into cell 403.
sentences.zh: 他们要求404号牢房里的所有警卫全部出来，并将他们转移到了403号牢房。

sentences.en: After tearing apart cell 404 in a frantic search and finding nothing,
sentences.zh: 在疯狂搜查并将404号牢房翻个底朝天却一无所获之后，

sentences.en: Koyi glanced at the toilet.
sentences.zh: 科伊瞥了一眼马桶。

sentences.en: He got on his hands and knees and reached into the toilet bowl.
sentences.zh: 他双膝跪地，将手伸进了马桶盆里。

sentences.en: He felt something metallic and heavy.
sentences.zh: 他摸到了一些冰冷而沉重的金属。

sentences.en: He grabbed the object and lifted his hand out.
sentences.zh: 他抓起那个物体，将手抽了出来。

sentences.en: Tied in his grasp was Key 107.
sentences.zh: 紧紧抓在他手中的正是107号钥匙。

sentences.en: In the prison's basement, Officer Ed Stucker patrolled the showering facility, barbershop and clothing room directly underneath the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 在监狱的地下室里，埃德·斯塔克尔警官正在主监舍正下方的淋浴区、理发店和衣物间巡逻。

sentences.en: He didn't engage the 21 prisoners under his watch in idle chit-chat.
sentences.zh: 他并没有和自己负责监视的21名囚犯闲聊。

sentences.en: Instead, Officer Stucker's authoritative nature kept the prisoners' heads down and mouths shut as they went about their work.
sentences.zh: 相反，斯塔克尔警官那威严的性格让囚犯们在干活时都低着头、闭着嘴。

sentences.en: For Stucker and the prisoners alike, May 2nd, 1946 was just another uneventful routine day in Alcatraz Prison.
sentences.zh: 对于斯塔克尔和囚犯们来说，1946年5月2日只是阿尔卡特拉斯监狱里又一个平静无波的日常。

sentences.en: Shortly after 1.30pm, two inmates who finished their duties early approached Officer Stucker, asking if they could spend the remainder of their scheduled
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分刚过，两名提前完成工作的囚犯找到斯塔克尔警官，询问是否可以在监狱娱乐场度过他们预定时间的

sentences.en: time in the prison recreation yard.
sentences.zh: 剩余时间。

sentences.en: Stucker agreed and allowed the inmates to go.
sentences.zh: 斯塔克尔同意了，并允许这两名囚犯前往。

sentences.en: The two inmates marched up the basement stairs towards the main cell house from where they could gain access to the recreation yard.
sentences.zh: 这两名囚犯沿着地下室的楼梯向上走去，走向主监舍，从那里他们可以通往娱乐场。

sentences.en: At the top of the stairs was a locked, steel-graded door.
sentences.zh: 楼梯顶部是一扇带锁的钢格门。

sentences.en: Unable to open the locked door, the inmates called out to get the attention of guards in the cell house.

sentences.zh: 但肖克利情绪失常，尖叫着要求克拉特泽完成任务。

sentences.en: Kretzer looked at Shockley yelling at him, then looked back at Largesen.
sentences.zh: 克拉特泽看着朝他大喊的肖克利，然后又转头看向拉格森。

sentences.en: As he pointed the revolver at the guard's head, he said,
sentences.zh: 当他将左轮手枪对准警卫的头部时，他说道：

sentences.en: I'm sorry Mr Largesen, then called the trigger.
sentences.zh: “对不起，拉格森先生，”随后扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: Seablock was hazy from the gunfire smoke, its concrete floors stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 由于枪火硝烟，海布洛克监区一片迷蒙，水泥地面上血迹斑斑。

sentences.en: Kretzer kept his eyes on the cells, and when he saw movement or heard moans, he fired more shots until the bodies were still and a deathly silence fell over the cell house.
sentences.zh: 克拉特泽死死盯着各个牢房，每当看到动静或听到呻吟声，他就继续开枪，直到尸体不再动弹，整个监舍陷入一片死寂。

sentences.en: Kretzer approached 18-year-old Clarence Carnes, handed the shocked young inmate the butcher's
sentences.zh: 克拉特泽走向18岁的克拉伦斯·卡恩斯，把从厨房拿来的屠夫

sentences.en: knife from the kitchen and ordered him to watch the cells and go in and slit the throat of anyone still breathing.
sentences.zh: 刀递给这个震惊的年轻囚犯，命令他看守牢房，并进去割断任何还在呼吸的人的喉咙。

sentences.en: Carnes peered intently into the cell and something caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 卡恩斯仔细窥探着牢房，有什么东西引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: The slight movements of chests rising and falling, shallow breathing.
sentences.zh: 胸膛起伏的微小动作，微弱的呼吸。

sentences.en: When Kretzer returned and asked if the officers were all dead, Carnes confirmed they were.
sentences.zh: 当克拉特泽回来并询问警官们是否全部死透时，卡恩斯确认他们都死了。

sentences.en: In an act that put the young man at great risk, he lied.
sentences.zh: 在一场将这位年轻男子置于巨大危险之中的行动中，他撒了谎。

sentences.en: He kept the breathing he had witnessed the secret.
sentences.zh: 他对自己目睹的呼吸声保守秘密。

sentences.en: With no possible way to get out, the escape had now turned into a siege.
sentences.zh: 由于无法逃脱，这场越狱现在变成了一场围困。

sentences.en: But Miren Thompson and Clarence Carnes didn't want any part of it.
sentences.zh: 但米伦·汤普森和克拉伦斯·卡恩斯不想参与其中。

sentences.en: They used their lack of firearms as an excuse and said they had no weapons to fight back and therefore didn't stand a chance.
sentences.zh: 他们以没有火器为借口，声称他们没有武器还击，因此毫无胜算。

sentences.en: They couldn't take on the armed guards with batons.
sentences.zh: 他们无法对付持有警棍的武装警卫。

sentences.en: The other escapees agreed and told Thompson and Carnes to return to their cells and take cover.
sentences.zh: 其他越狱者表示同意，并叫汤普森和卡恩斯回到各自的牢房寻找掩护。

sentences.en: When Thompson and Carnes got to their cells, they cleaned the officer's blood off their clothes, hoping they wouldn't be blamed for the slaughter of the guards.
sentences.zh: 当汤普森和卡恩斯回到牢房时，他们洗掉了衣服上的警官血迹，希望不会被指控屠杀警卫。

sentences.en: Kretzer looked at crazy Sam Shockley who seemed to be lost in his own mind, unaware of what was going on around him.
sentences.zh: 克雷策看着疯狂的萨姆·肖克利，他似乎迷失在自己的思绪中，对周围发生的事情毫无所知。

sentences.en: Perhaps feeling guilty for involving the unstable childlike man in their violence, Kretzer told Shockley to return to his cell.
sentences.zh: 克雷策可能对将这个性格不稳定、像孩子一样的男人卷入他们的暴力行为感到内疚，于是叫肖克利回牢房去。

sentences.en: Shockley turned and walked away without a word.
sentences.zh: 肖克利一言不发地转身走开。

sentences.en: Several prison officers staged multiple rescue attempts, hoping to get their colleagues out of the cell house.
sentences.zh: 几名狱警组织了多次救援尝试，希望能把同事从监舍里救出来。

sentences.en: They were unaware that Kretzer had already taken them out.
sentences.zh: 他们并不知道克雷策已经把他们解决了。

sentences.en: Each rescue attempt was met with a peppering of bullets from the armed escapees inside.
sentences.zh: 每一次救援尝试都遭到里面武装越狱者的密集枪击。

sentences.en: Escapees and officers exchanged bullets, both sides firing with complete disregard and intent to kill.
sentences.zh: 越狱者和警官们互相开枪，双方都毫无顾忌、抱着必杀的决心开火。

sentences.en: Officer Birch, who had been restrained in the gallery since the start of the breakout, tied to the electrical piping, was eventually able to be rescued.
sentences.zh: 伯奇警官自越狱开始就被绑在走廊的电气管道上，最终获救。

sentences.en: The answer to the question, how did Bernie Coy infiltrate the gun gallery, was finally answered when the rescuing officers looked up to see the
sentences.zh: 当救援警官抬头看到令人惊叹的弯曲铁条，并找到了他自制的撑条装置时，伯尼·科伊是如何潜入枪械走廊的这个问题终于有了答案。

sentences.en: impressive sight of bent bars and they found his makeshift bar spreading device.
sentences.zh: 弯曲的栏杆呈现出令人印象深刻的景象，他们找到了他自制的撑开栏杆的装置。

sentences.en: Many officers were badly wounded.
sentences.zh: 许多警官身受重伤。

sentences.en: Officer Harold Stites was struck by a stray bullet and lay motionless at the southwest corner of D Block bleeding profusely.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德·斯泰茨警官被流弹击中，一动不动地倒在D区西南角，血流如注。

sentences.en: When other officers finally got to Stites he was unconscious and unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 当其他警官终于赶到斯泰茨身边时，他已经失去知觉，没有反应。

sentences.en: He was dragged to safety where the severity of his wounds was realised.
sentences.zh: 他被拖到安全地带，人们这才意识到他伤势的严重性。

sentences.en: Officer Stites was pronounced dead soon after.
sentences.zh: 不久后，斯泰茨警官被宣告死亡。

sentences.en: At 3.30pm, the Coast Guard, the Army, the Navy, the Marines, the San Francisco Police Department, the Bureau of Prisons,
sentences.zh: 下午3点30分，海岸警卫队、陆军、海军、海军陆战队、旧金山警察局、联邦监狱局、

sentences.en: and off-duty Alcatraz prison officers arrived to Alcatraz Island to help take back the cell house.
sentences.zh: 以及休假的恶魔岛狱警抵达恶魔岛，协助夺回监舍。

sentences.en: The military brought a full arsenal of weaponry that could completely wipe out the prison building if necessary.
sentences.zh: 军方带来了全套武器库，如有必要，可以彻底摧毁监狱大楼。

sentences.en: They were prepared to storm the building in a blaze of bullets and flash grenades, but Warden Johnston deemed it too risky to send in an armed assault team.
sentences.zh: 他们准备在枪林弹雨和闪光弹中强攻大楼，但乔斯顿监狱长认为派遣武装突击队风险太大。

sentences.en: He couldn't confirm how many inmates were involved in the siege.
sentences.zh: 他无法确认有多少犯人参与了围困。

sentences.en: A known humanitarian, Warden Johnston also didn't want to risk the lives of the hostages.
sentences.zh: 作为一名众名人道主义者，乔斯顿监狱长也不想拿人质的生命去冒风险。

sentences.en: Instead, he wanted to try communicating with the escapees.
sentences.zh: 相反，他希望尝试与越狱者沟通。

sentences.en: Officers climbed up the outside of the prison to broken windows facing into the cell house.
sentences.zh: 警官们从监狱外侧爬到面向监舍的破窗户旁。

sentences.en: When they called out to the escapees inside and told them to surrender.
sentences.zh: 当他们向里面的越狱者喊话并叫他们投降时。

sentences.en: Kretz's voice shouted back that they would not be taken alive.
sentences.zh: 克雷策的声音回喊道，他们绝不会活着被捕。

sentences.en: Come and get us, he screamed.
sentences.zh: 有本事来抓我们，他尖叫道。

sentences.en: Officers fired in the cell house from the windows.
sentences.zh: 警官们从窗户向监舍内开枪。

sentences.en: The bullets ricocheting off concrete and steel was deafening as tear gas canisters also filled
sentences.zh: 子弹击中混凝土和钢铁的反弹声震耳欲聋，催泪瓦斯罐也让

sentences.en: the building with burning miSt. The searing hot shrapnel of exploding grenades injured and knocked out innocent inmates caught in the crossfire.
sentences.zh: 整栋大楼充满了灼热的雾霾。爆炸手雷灼热的弹片炸伤并击昏了卷入交火的无辜犯人。

sentences.en: Prisoners scrambled for cover as the inner steel workings of the building expanded and contracted with the explosions.
sentences.zh: 随着大楼内部的钢铁结构因爆炸而膨胀和收缩，犯人们争相寻找掩护。

sentences.en: The cellhouse lit up in bright smoky colours of white, yellow and red as freezing seawater rained down from destroyed plumbing fixtures.
sentences.zh: 由于被毁坏的水管喷洒出冰冷的海水，监舍被白、黄、红三色明亮的烟雾照亮。

sentences.en: Barricades were built out of wet mattresses, books and blankets, but they proved useless against the fiery bullets and explosions.
sentences.zh: 用湿床垫、书籍和毛毯搭建的路障在炽热的子弹和爆炸面前毫无用处。

sentences.en: Koi and Kretzer fired back from the smoke and rubble, forcing officers to retreat.
sentences.zh: 科伊和克雷策在烟雾和瓦砾中还击，迫使警官们撤退。

sentences.en: The battle lasted over five hours.
sentences.zh: 战斗持续了五个多小时。

sentences.en: By 9pm, the intensity waned, and by 10pm, the entire cell house fell completely silent.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点前，火力减弱；到晚上10点，整个监舍彻底陷入死寂。

sentences.en: Warden Johnston finally agreed to send an armed assault team to storm the building to rescue the hostages and take out the armed inmates.
sentences.zh: 乔斯顿监狱长最终同意派遣武装突击队强攻大楼，以营救人质并消灭武装犯人。

sentences.en: At 11.05pm, ten armed officers slowly opened the heavy steel door leading into the cell house.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点05分，十名武装警官缓缓推开通往监舍的厚重钢门。

sentences.en: They crept into the darkness with weapons poised.
sentences.zh: 他们手持武器，潜入黑暗中。

sentences.en: Progressing quickly and quietly down the corridors, they examined each cell they passed.
sentences.zh: 他们沿走廊迅速而安静地前进，检查路过的每一个牢房。

sentences.en: At this stage, they were unsure which prisoners were involved in the siege, so they had to suspect everyone they came across.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们不确定哪些犯人参与了围困，因此必须对遇到的所有人保持怀疑。

sentences.en: They saw cowering inmates squeezed under cots and huddled into corners.
sentences.zh: 他们看到畏缩的犯人挤在帆布床下，蜷缩在角落里。

sentences.en: Some had fallen asleep, exhausted.
sentences.zh: 有些人精疲力竭，已经睡着了。

sentences.en: The anxious assault team pointed their guns towards every click, crack and clutter.
sentences.zh: 焦虑的突击队对每一个点击声、爆裂声和杂音都把枪指向哪里。

sentences.en: They knew the armed inmates were hidden in the shadows around them somewhere, waiting.
sentences.zh: 他们知道武装犯人正隐藏在周围的阴影中某个地方，伺机而动。

sentences.en: Bernie Coy was perched on the top tier of C Block, watching the assault team sneak below.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊蹲在C区的最上层，看着突击队在下方潜行。

sentences.en: He aimed his rifle and fired.
sentences.zh: 他瞄准步枪开火了。

sentences.en: The assault team retreated under the walkway directly beneath his location, only emerging to fire back.
sentences.zh: 突击队在他所在位置正下方的走道下撤退，只有出来还击时才露面。

sentences.en: Drastically outnumbered, Bernie Coy was forced to retreat.
sentences.zh: 由于寡不敌众，伯尼·科伊被迫撤退。

sentences.en: The assault team hastily moved down C-Block and noticed a thick, dark puddle of liquid seeping out from cells 403 and 404.
sentences.zh: 突击队匆忙穿过C区，注意到403和404号牢房里渗出一滩粘稠、黑暗的液体。

sentences.en: Inside, they were confronted with blood-splattered walls and the unmoving bodies of their colleagues spread out on the floor.
sentences.zh: 在里面，呈现在他们眼前的是溅满鲜血的墙壁，以及同事们一动不动地躺在地板上的尸体。

sentences.en: As they tried to make sense of what they were seeing, they were shocked to see some of the bodies begin to move.
sentences.zh: 正当他们试图理解眼前的一切时，震惊地发现一些尸体开始动了。

sentences.en: Having played dead for almost
sentences.zh: 在装死将近

sentences.en: 10 hours, officers Burdett, Bristow and Sundström crawled out miraculously unhurt.
sentences.zh: 10个小时后，伯德特、布里斯托和松斯特伦警官奇迹般地毫发无伤地爬了出来。

sentences.en: Officer Largesson also emerged.
sentences.zh: 拉格森警官也出现了。

sentences.en: He'd been shot in the face, but luckily, the bullet only grazed him.
sentences.zh: 他的脸部中弹，但幸运的是，子弹只是擦伤了他。

sentences.en: Those that could walk helped lift and carry those who couldn't.
sentences.zh: 能走路的人帮忙扶着并抬着走不动的人。

sentences.en: Officer Baker had two bullet wounds in his left leg and another in his thigh.
sentences.zh: 贝克警官的左腿有两处枪伤，大腿上还有一处。

sentences.en: Captain Weinhold, Lieutenant Simpson and Officers Miller and Corwin were in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 维因霍尔德上尉、辛普森中尉以及米勒和科温警官情况危急。

sentences.en: It was nearing midnight when the hostages emerged safely from the cell house.
sentences.zh: 临近午夜时分，人质们安全地走出了监舍。

sentences.en: The critically wounded officers were loaded onto ferries and taken to hospitals on the mainland to receive emergency surgery.
sentences.zh: 身受重伤的警官被抬上渡轮，送到大陆的医院接受紧急手术。

sentences.en: Captain Winehold and Lieutenant Simpson were operated on firSt.
sentences.zh: 维因霍尔德上尉和辛普森中尉首先接受了手术。

sentences.en: Officers Corwin and Miller were next.
sentences.zh: 接下来是科温和米勒警官。

sentences.en: The remainder of the hostages were able to detail the attempted breakout and identify who was involved.
sentences.zh: 其余人质得以详细描述未遂越狱的过程并辨认参与人员。

sentences.en: At 7am the following morning, May 3rd, the siege entered its second day as the orchestrators refused to surrender.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上7点，即5月3日，随着策划者拒绝投降，围困进入了第二天。

sentences.en: That morning, news reached prison staff that Officer William Miller had gone into shock as a result of severe blood loss.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，监狱工作人员接到消息称，威廉·米勒警官因严重失血而陷入休克。

sentences.en: Shortly after, he went into cardiac arrest and couldn't be resuscitated.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他心脏骤停，未能抢救过来。

sentences.en: As the sun rose over San Francisco and the building was now free of hostages, hellfire rained down on Alcatraz Prison.
sentences.zh: 当太阳在旧金山升起，大楼人质获释时，烈火如雨般倾泻在恶魔岛监狱上。

sentences.en: Gas grenades dropped into the cell house through ventilators.
sentences.zh: 毒气弹通过通风口投掷到监舍内。

sentences.en: Grenades were lowered through holes drilled in the prison roof and detonated.
sentences.zh: 手榴弹通过在监狱屋顶上钻的孔放下并引爆。

sentences.en: Relentless gunfire dotted the building as marines fired anti-tank shells striking the prisons outer walls.
sentences.zh: 随着海军陆战队发射反坦克炮弹击中监狱外墙，密集的枪声点缀着整栋大楼。

sentences.en: The onslaught was a spectacular sight to the thousands of civilians watching from the mainland, but was absolutely terrifying to the inmates trapped in the cell house.
sentences.zh: 对于从大陆观看的数千名平民来说，这场猛烈攻击是一场壮观的景象，但对于被困在监舍里的犯人来说，绝对是极其恐怖的。

sentences.en: The frightened and injured inmates were convinced they were going to die and could be heard crying out for help from the smoking building.
sentences.zh: 惊恐受伤的犯人们坚信自己必死无疑，可以听到他们在冒烟的大楼里呼救。

sentences.en: One officer commented, that's one hell of a breakfast they're serving.
sentences.zh: 一位警官评论道，他们提供的早餐真够受的。

sentences.en: The bombardment lasted the entire day and carried on into the night.
sentences.zh: 猛烈的轰炸持续了一整天，并一直延续到深夜。

sentences.en: During brief moments of reprieve, gunfire would spark from the battered prison building, confirming Coy, Kretzer and Hubbard
sentences.zh: 在短暂的喘息时刻，残破的监狱大楼里会迸发出枪声，这证实了科伊、克雷策和哈伯德

sentences.en: were still alive somewhere inside, and unwilling to surrender.
sentences.zh: 仍然活着在里面的某个地方，并且不愿投降。

sentences.en: So the bombing recommenced.
sentences.zh: 于是轰炸重新开始。

sentences.en: The battle ended at 8.40am the next day, May 4th, 43 hours after Coy instigated his grand escape from Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 战斗于第二天（5月4日）上午8点40分结束，距离科伊发起伟大的恶魔岛越狱行动已有43小时。

sentences.en: No gunfire had been heard from the cell house for hours, so armed officers cautiously entered the prison to determine the fate of the escapees.
sentences.zh: 监舍已经几个小时没有听到枪声，武装警官小心翼翼地进入监狱，以确定越狱者的命运。

sentences.en: Cell blocks A, B and D were cleared and secured, leading the officers to believe the armed inmates were cornered in C block.
sentences.zh: A、B和D监区已被清理并确保安全，这让警官们相信武装犯人已被逼入C区。

sentences.en: They paced by the recreation yard door.
sentences.zh: 他们在娱乐场大门旁踱步。

sentences.en: The inmates intended means of escape, which was still lockdown.
sentences.zh: 犯人们原本打算的逃生手段，依然处于封锁状态。

sentences.en: As the officers descended on Seablock, rushing up each level and raiding all the cells along the way, Coy, Kretzer and Hubbard were nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 当警官们突袭海区，冲上每一层并沿途搜查所有牢房时，科伊、克雷策和哈伯德不知去向。

sentences.en: An officer cautiously opened the door to the utility corridor nestled in the centre of Seablock.
sentences.zh: 一名警官小心翼翼地打开了位于海区中心的公用走廊的门。

sentences.en: It reeked of raw sewage as the bombing and gunfire had severed the plumbing inside.
sentences.zh: 由于轰炸和枪击切断了内部管道，里面散发着生下水道的恶臭。

sentences.en: The officer called out a warning and was met with silence.
sentences.zh: 警官大声发出警告，迎来的却是一片寂静。

sentences.en: As he stepped inside, his searchlight illuminated the body of Bernie
sentences.zh: 当他踏入其中时，他的探照灯照亮了伯尼的尸体

sentences.en: Coy by the doorway.
sentences.zh: 科伊倒在门口。

sentences.en: His eyes were open and glazed, pupils fixed.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛睁着，目光呆滞，瞳孔固定。

sentences.en: Dried blood had crusted beneath his nostrils.
sentences.zh: 他的鼻孔下结了干血痂。

sentences.en: He had a cut across the left side of his face and a weeping gunshot wound through his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的左脸有一道伤口，脖子上有一个流脓的枪伤。

sentences.en: His rifle was by his side, loaded and ready to fire with additional ammunition close by.
sentences.zh: 他的步枪就在身旁，已上膛准备射击，附近还有额外的弹药。

sentences.en: Lying next to Koi was the body of Joseph Kretzer, covered in bleeding abrasions.
sentences.zh: 躺在科伊旁边的是约瑟夫·克雷策的尸体，布满流血的擦伤。

sentences.en: He had a gunshot wound to his head.
sentences.zh: 他的头部有一处枪伤。

sentences.en: Around his body was the revolver he used to shoot his hostages, as well as various keys he had stolen from the guards.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体周围是他用来枪击人质的手枪，以及他从警卫那里偷来的各种钥匙。

sentences.en: Found in the pocket of the jacket he was wearing was a crumpled piece of paper featuring a poem he'd written, titled Death.
sentences.zh: 在他穿的夹克口袋里发现了一张揉皱的纸，上面写着他写的一首诗，题为《死亡》。

sentences.en: There has been death this day and there will be more.
sentences.zh: 今天已有死亡发生，还将有更多。

sentences.en: Many men will come across the prison floor.
sentences.zh: 许多人将走过监狱的地板。

sentences.en: They will kill me, of that there is no doubt.
sentences.zh: 他们会杀死我，这一点毫无疑问。

sentences.en: There are many ways in, but no way out.
sentences.zh: 有许多路可以进来，却没有退路。

sentences.en: My life has reached its final span.
sentences.zh: 我的人生已到尽头。

sentences.en: There is nothing left but to do what I can.
sentences.zh: 除了尽我所能，别无他法。

sentences.en: They won't kill a convict.
sentences.zh: 他们不会杀死一个囚犯。

sentences.en: They'll kill a man.
sentences.zh: 他们会杀死一个人。

sentences.en: Both Koi and Kretzer were wearing correctional officers' uniforms and their bodies were stiff from rigor mortis.
sentences.zh: 科伊和克雷策都穿着惩教警官的制服，他们的尸体因尸僵而僵硬。

sentences.en: At the very opposite end of the corridor was the body of Marvin Hubbard.
sentences.zh: 走廊的极尽处是马文·哈伯德的尸体。

sentences.en: Hubbard's body was still warm, confirming he was the last to die, and that he had been killed hours after Coy and Kretzer.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德的尸体仍然温热，这证实他是最后一个死去的，而且他在科伊和克雷策死后数小时才被杀。

sentences.en: He had two bullet wounds to the back of his head.
sentences.zh: 他的后脑勺有两处枪伤。

sentences.en: Hubbard had no firearms around his body, only the butcher's knife he had stolen from the kitchen at the start of the escape attempt.
sentences.zh: 哈伯德尸体周围没有火器，只有他在越狱企图开始时从厨房偷来的屠刀。

sentences.en: Investigating officers believed Hubbard didn't fight alone until the bitter end.
sentences.zh: 调查警官认为哈伯德并非孤军奋战到最后一刻。

sentences.en: Instead, he waited patiently for his inevitable death from the raining gunfire and grenades.
sentences.zh: 相反，他耐心等待着枪林弹雨和手榴弹带来的不可避免的死亡。

sentences.en: None of the failed escapees died by their own hand.
sentences.zh: 没有一个失败的越狱者是自杀身亡的。

sentences.en: It was later determined that Officer Harold
sentences.zh: 后来确定哈罗德警官

sentences.en: Stites, who was the first casualty of what was to be called the Battle of Alcatraz, was killed accidentally by friendly fire.
sentences.zh: 斯泰茨是被称为恶魔岛战役的第一位伤亡者，他是在友军火力下意外身亡的。

sentences.en: His funeral service was held on May 7th 1946, surrounded by his family and Alcatraz prison colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的葬礼于1946年5月7日举行，他的家人和恶魔岛监狱的同事们环绕在侧。

sentences.en: The body of Officer William Miller, who was shot by Joseph Kretzer and later died of his injuries, was returned to his hometown
sentences.zh: 被约瑟夫·克雷策枪击并不治身亡的威廉·米勒警官的遗体被送回他的家乡

sentences.en: state of Pennsylvania, where he was laid to rest after a small service.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州，在举行小型葬礼后安葬于此。

sentences.en: Officer Miller was regarded a hero for bravely keeping Key 107 from the inmates, ensuring they couldn't get out of the
sentences.zh: 米勒警官被视为英雄，因为他勇敢地为犯人们保管107号钥匙，确保他们无法逃出

sentences.en: cell house, where they would have had the opportunity to harm many others.
sentences.zh: 监舍，否则他们本有机会伤害许多其他人。

sentences.en: The following is a written tribute to the two fallen officers.
sentences.zh: 以下是对两位阵亡警官的书面悼词。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述，

sentences.en: when men of courage and steadfastness lose their lives in the faithful performance of their duty there is little that need be said by those of us who did not face the danger
sentences.zh: 当勇敢而坚定的男儿在忠实履行职责时失去生命时，我们这些没有面对危险的人无需多言

sentences.en: their deeds speak far more eloquently but i am sure there is no one in the entire federal prison
sentences.zh: 他们的事迹比任何言语都更能说明问题，但我确信整个联邦监狱系统中

sentences.en: system whose heart is not quickened with pride and at the same time saddened with a very real
sentences.zh: 没有人不会在威廉·米勒和哈罗德·斯泰茨这样英雄般的人物作出最高牺牲时，内心涌起骄傲，同时又伴随着一种非常真实的失落感。

sentences.en: sense of loss when two such heroic men as william miller and harold stites make the supreme sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 当威廉·米勒和哈罗德·斯泰茨这样两位英雄人物做出最伟大的牺牲时，那种失落感油然而生。

sentences.en: The other critically wounded hostages from Joseph Kretzer's shooting spree, Weinhold,
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·克雷策枪击狂潮中其他受重伤的人质，维因霍尔德、

sentences.en: Simpson and Corwin, all made full recoveries, as did all the other officers and inmates who suffered injuries during the Battle of Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 辛普森和科温都完全康复了，所有在恶魔岛战役中受伤的其他警官和犯人也是如此。

sentences.en: After a 12-minute boat ride to the San Francisco docks across the bay, Bernie Coy, Joseph Kretzer and Marvin Hubbard finally found freedom from
sentences.zh: 经过12分钟的船程穿过海湾到达旧金山码头，伯尼·科伊、约瑟夫·克雷策和马文·哈伯德终于从

sentences.en: Alcatraz prison.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱获得了自由。

sentences.en: No one claimed Coy's remains.
sentences.zh: 没有人认领科伊的遗体。

sentences.en: His body was put in a plain pinewood coffin and buried in an unmarked grave at Woodlawn Cemetery in South San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体被放在一个简陋的松木棺材里，埋葬在旧金山南部伍德劳恩公墓的一个无名墓穴中。

sentences.en: Joseph Kretzer's body was cremated and his ashes placed in an unmarked burial vault at Cypress Lawn Cemetery in Colma,
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·克雷策的尸体被火化，骨灰安放在加利福尼亚州科尔马

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: Cypress Lawn公墓的一个无名墓穴中。

sentences.en: Marvin Hubbard's wife arranged to have his remains transferred to his hometown of
sentences.zh: 马文·哈伯德的妻子安排将他的遗体运回他的家乡

sentences.en: Alabama, where he was buried in Shady Grove Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州，并安葬在Shady Grove公墓。

sentences.en: Sketched with pencil on the rough concrete wall of Cell 403 was a list of names.
sentences.zh: 403号牢房粗糙的混凝土墙上用铅笔素描着一个名字名单。

sentences.en: Fearing all the hostages would end up dead, including himself.
sentences.zh: 由于担心所有人质最终都会丧生，包括他自己。

sentences.en: Officer Ernie Largeson wanted to make sure those investigating later could identify his killers.
sentences.zh: 欧内斯特·拉格森警官想要确保后来的调查人员能够识别他的杀手。

sentences.en: On the wall, he wrote the names Kretzer, Coy, Karnes, Hubbard,
sentences.zh: 他在墙上写下了克雷策、科伊、卡恩斯、哈伯德的名字，

sentences.en: Thompson, and Shockley.
sentences.zh: 汤普森和肖克利。

sentences.en: He circled the ringleaders, Kretzer, Coy, and Hubbard.
sentences.zh: 他圈出了主谋克雷策、科伊和哈伯德。

sentences.en: Next to Kretzer's name was a tick, labelling him as the killer.
sentences.zh: 克雷策的名字旁有一个勾，標記他為兇手。

sentences.en: But this evidence wasn't needed in the end, as almost all the hostages managed to survive.
sentences.zh: 不过最终并不需要这些证据，因为几乎所有人都质幸存了下来。

sentences.en: They were able to detail exactly what happened in the cell house, including who was involved and in what capacity.
sentences.zh: 他们能够详细描述囚室里发生的一切，包括谁参与了以及各自的角色。

sentences.en: Sam Shockley, Mirren Thompson and Clarence Carnes were singled out for their involvement.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·肖克利、米伦·汤普森和克拉伦斯·卡恩斯因参与其中而被单独点名。

sentences.en: On November 20th 1946, the three surviving conspirators were put on trial for the murder of Officer William Miller.
sentences.zh: 1946年11月20日，三名幸存的策划者因谋杀警员威廉·米勒而受审。

sentences.en: Other Alcatraz inmates testified on behalf of the three, stating the cruel and harsh nature of operations inside Alcatraz prison
sentences.zh: 其他恶魔岛囚犯为这三人作证，指出恶魔岛监狱内部残酷严苛的运作方式

sentences.en: compelled the prisoners to want to escape, or die trying.
sentences.zh: 迫使囚犯们想要越狱，或者拼死一试。

sentences.en: Anything was better than Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 任何地方都比恶魔岛强。

sentences.en: Most defended Sam Shockley in particular, claiming Shockley was not mentally fit to stand trial with his low IQ and mental age.
sentences.zh: 大多数人特别为萨姆·肖克利辩护，称肖克利智商低下、心理年龄不成熟，不具备接受审判的精神状态。

sentences.en: They argued he was more so a manipulated victim than a key conspirator.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，与其说他是核心策划者，不如说他是一个被操纵的受害者。

sentences.en: Seven inmates testified that Shockley was, quote, stir-crazy, and thus couldn't fully comprehend the repercussions of his actions.
sentences.zh: 七名囚犯作证说，肖克利引用原话是“精神失常”，因此无法完全理解其行为的后果。

sentences.en: They added that Shockley's unmedicated psychosis was amplified by the conditions in which prisoners were kept in Alcatraz, stating that imprisonment on the rock drove even the most
sentences.zh: 他们补充说，恶魔岛囚犯的生存环境放大了肖克利未经治疗的精神病，并表示在这块礁石上关押甚至会让最

sentences.en: sane men crazy.
sentences.zh: 理智的人发疯。

sentences.en: 18-year-old Clarence Carnes was also defended by his fellow prisoners.
sentences.zh: 18岁的克拉伦斯·卡恩斯也得到了狱友们的辩护。

sentences.en: One inmate described Carnes as, quote, a puppy tailing the heels of the tough guys.
sentences.zh: 一名囚犯将卡恩斯形容为引用原话“跟在硬汉脚后跟后面的一只小狗”。

sentences.en: He was seen as a voluntary, though very naive, participant.
sentences.zh: 他被视为一个出于自愿但极其天真的参与者。

sentences.en: The trial lasted over a month.
sentences.zh: 审判持续了一个多月。

sentences.en: and on December 21st, 1946, the verdict was in.
sentences.zh: 1946年12月21日，判决出炉。

sentences.en: All three men were found guilty and were convicted of the first-degree murder of Officer William Miller.
sentences.zh: 这三名男子全部被判有罪，犯有谋杀警员威廉·米勒的一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: Sam Shockley and Mirren Thompson were sentenced to death.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·肖克利和米伦·汤普森被判处死刑。

sentences.en: Thompson stated afterwards, quote,
sentences.zh: 汤普森随后表示，引用原话：

sentences.en: It's just as well.
sentences.zh: 这样也挺好。

sentences.en: I'd rather have it that way than go back to the rock.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿这样，也不愿回到那块礁石上去。

sentences.en: It was known that Clarence Carnes actually saved the lives of the hostages by lying to Kretzer, stating they were all dead when he knew they weren't.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，克拉伦斯·卡恩斯对克雷特瑟撒了谎，谎称人质都死了（当时他明知没有），以此实际上救了人质们的命。

sentences.en: For his act of mercy, Carnes was spared the death penalty and instead given a life sentence to be served in Alcatraz prison.
sentences.zh: 由于他的仁慈之举，卡恩斯免于死刑，转而被判处在恶魔岛监狱服无期徒刑。

sentences.en: He was kept in solitary confinement for six years before returning to general prison population where he became a model inmate and thrived in the prison environment.
sentences.zh: 他在单人禁闭室被关了六年，之后才回到普通犯人群体，在那里他成为了一个模范囚犯，在监狱环境中表现极佳。

sentences.en: Shockley and Thompson were immediately transferred to death row in San Quentin State Prison located north of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 肖克利和汤普森被立即转移到位于旧金山以北的圣昆廷州立监狱的死囚牢房。

sentences.en: While on death row, Thompson was found to be making a key in another escape plot.
sentences.zh: 在死囚牢房期间，人们发现汤普森在另一个越狱阴谋中制作了一把钥匙。

sentences.en: Both men appealed their sentences on the grounds that Joseph Kretzer alone had murdered Officer
sentences.zh: 两名男子对判决提出上诉，理由是只有约瑟夫·克雷特瑟一人谋杀了警员

sentences.en: Miller and that they were somehow found guilty for his crime.
sentences.zh: 米勒，而他们却莫名其妙地被判犯有他的罪行。

sentences.en: Their appeals were denied.
sentences.zh: 他们的上诉被驳回。

sentences.en: At 7am on December 3rd, 1948, two years after the Battle of Alcatraz, Sam Shockley and Mirren Thompson ate their final meal in adjacent cells.
sentences.zh: 1948年12月3日上午7点，即恶魔岛战役两年后，萨姆·肖克利和米伦·汤普森在相邻的牢房里吃下了他们的最后晚餐。

sentences.en: Shortly before 10am, the two men were walked side by side to the gas chamber, where in front of an audience of Alcatraz prison staff, they inhaled cyanide gas.
sentences.zh: 在上午10点前不久，两人并肩走向毒气室，在恶魔岛监狱工作人员的围观下，他们吸入了氰化物毒气。

sentences.en: They were pronounced dead soon after.
sentences.zh: 不久后，他们被宣布死亡。

sentences.en: After the dust had settled, Alcatraz prison continued on as normal, slowly repairing itself.
sentences.zh: 风波平息后，恶魔岛监狱一如既往地继续运转，慢慢进行着修缮。

sentences.en: Its concrete walls were pockmarked from bullets and its steel framing was bent from the explosive pressure of grenades.
sentences.zh: 它那混凝土墙壁上布满了子弹留下的麻点，钢结构也被手榴弹的爆炸压力扭曲了。

sentences.en: The floor and walls were fractured from shrapnel damage.
sentences.zh: 地板和墙壁因弹片破坏而残破不堪。

sentences.en: However, one thing remained perfectly intact.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一件事却完好无损。

sentences.en: Alcatraz prison's reputation as being completely escape-proof.
sentences.zh: 那就是恶魔岛监狱号称绝对无法越狱的声誉。

sentences.en: Due to the extensive damage done to the main cell house, prisoners were locked up two, three or four to a single cell.
sentences.zh: 由于主监舍遭到严重破坏，囚犯们被两名、三名或四名地关在同一个牢房里。

sentences.en: Anxious guards no longer trusted prisoners, especially those who were well-behaved and trusted, like Bernie Coy had been.
sentences.zh: 焦虑的警卫不再信任囚犯，尤其是像伯尼·科伊那样曾经表现良好且备受信任的人。

sentences.en: Guards became paranoid and constantly searched inmates in their cells, convinced more violent escapes were being planned behind their backs.
sentences.zh: 警卫们变得偏执，不断搜查囚犯的牢房，坚信在他们背后正策划着更多暴力的越狱。

sentences.en: But they found nothing.
sentences.zh: 但他们什么也没找到。

sentences.en: The handling of the Alcatraz siege was commended by James Bennett, the head of all federal penitentiaries, who stated,
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛围困事件的处理得到了所有联邦监狱负责人詹姆斯·贝特的赞扬，他表示：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: inmates, the responsibility of the Battle of Alcatraz was placed on the prison itself.
sentences.zh: 犯人们，恶魔岛战役的责任在于监狱本身。

sentences.en: One Alcatraz ex-convict stated shortly after the battle, quote,
sentences.zh: 一名恶魔岛前囚犯在战役结束后不久表示，引用：

sentences.en: I'm out now.
sentences.zh: 我现在出来了。

sentences.en: I've got no beef.
sentences.zh: 我没有什么不满。

sentences.en: I just want to see something done so things like this riot won't ever happen again.
sentences.zh: 我只是想看到采取一些行动，好让这次暴动这样的事情再也不会发生。

sentences.en: I know that if they'd treated the prisoners half civilly, they wouldn't react like vicious beasts.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果他们能对囚犯有一半的文明对待，囚犯们就不会像恶兽一样做出反应。

sentences.en: You can't coop up men and take all hope away from them.
sentences.zh: 你不能把人关在笼子里并夺走他们所有的希望。

sentences.en: Warden Johnston always says the trouble with Alcatraz prisoners is that they want their freedom that's right
sentences.zh: 强斯顿狱长总是说恶魔岛囚犯的问题在于他们渴望自由，确实如此

sentences.en: they want to get out
sentences.zh: 他们想要逃出去
